descriptor.scene: From a small clearing in the jungle, the view opens upward: the canopy parts like a green window, and high in the warm open sky floats the island, exactly as the locked establishing plate paints it: a gentle teardrop of pale rock trailing thin mist, terraced gardens and low cream buildings on top, slender brass wind-spires catching the light. It is far, high, and unreachable; birds near it read as specks. At the clearing's edge, low in the left of frame, two anonymous travelers stand small with their backs to the camera, looking up at it. The lower right of the frame stays calm: leaves and soft light.
descriptor._caption: Up is an island in the sky. It floats above the canopy in plain view, near enough to see its gardens and its bright machines, too far for any tree to reach. The people below call it Founder Heaven.
